verdict.rationale: Availability through third-party clouds or gateways is a fair question for an LLM API, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions Azure, Bedrock, Vertex, OpenRouter or any other route outside OpenAI's own endpoint. The docs only describe OpenAI's own API keys, SDKs and endpoints.

support.subject: As a founder, I can consume the same models through major clouds or gateways — Bedrock, Vertex, Azure, or OpenRouter-class routers — not only the vendor's own endpoint
